title: Super Interdimensional Fight Bonanza
alt: Super Interdimensional Fight Bonanza game thumbnail
description:
A Unity game made for DreamLayer GameJam 2026. I developed the gameplay programming and game systems, including QTE-driven boxing combat, ScriptableObject-configured fighters and FMOD interactive audio.

I also created a Unity Editor tool for DreamLayer API asset generation, download and import with AI assistance. The playable WebGL build is available here.
subtitle: DreamLayer GameJam 2026

title: Roguelite Demo
subtitle: Unity / C# / Game Feel & System Architecture
description: An independently developed Unity and C# gameplay project, built without AI-generated code. It includes concurrent movement and combat state machines, timed attack phases, hit detection and reactions, enemy patrol and chase behavior, pooling, and ScriptableObject-based skills, buffs and cooldowns.

title: Merge Fruits
subtitle: Unity / C# · Suika Game Clone
description: A Suika Game clone built in Unity as a learning exercise in 2D physics, data-driven design and mobile input handling.

title: 16BarLogic
subtitle: Unity / C# / FMOD / State Machine Logic
description:
An adaptive music demo built in Unity and FMOD, using a seven-state music FSM with BPM/bar-quantized transitions, state timers and priority locks. It uses vertical layering and horizontal resequencing to change musical stems and sections in response to gameplay states.

I worked on the audio design, DSP calculations and acoustic logic. Player movement and combat triggers were built with AI assistance to test the audio systems. The Roguelite Demo covers my separate work on gameplay programming.

title: DSP-DEMO
subtitle: Unity / C# / FMOD Middleware
description:
A room acoustics and source occlusion demo built in Unity and FMOD. Flood-fill and six-axis raycasting estimate room geometry, volume and material hardness at runtime. These values control FMOD parameters for reverb time, early and late delay, diffusion, high cut and low gain.

I worked on the audio design, DSP calculations and acoustic logic. Player movement and combat triggers were built with AI assistance to test the audio systems. The Roguelite Demo covers my separate work on gameplay programming.
